quartz.config.yaml.text:
configuration:
  pageTitle: Quelle
  locale: de-DE
  baseUrl: example.org
  theme:
    fontOrigin: local
    cdnCaching: false
    typography:
      header: Inter
      body: Source Sans Pro
      code: IBM Plex Mono
    colors:
      lightMode:
        light: "#ffffff"
        dark: "#2b2b2b"
      darkMode:
        light: "#161618"
        dark: "#ebebec"
plugins: 
  - source: "@quartz-themes/core"
    enabled: true
    options:
      theme: tokyo-night
      styleSettings:
        accent: blue
        width: wide
  - source: "@quartz-community/explorer"
    enabled: true
    layout:
      position: left
      priority: 20
  - source: "@quartz-community/backlinks"
    enabled: false
  - source: "@quartz-community/explorer"
    enabled: false
  - source: github:boxi-os/quartz-layout-box
    enabled: true
    options:
      title: Erste
  - source: github:boxi-os/quartz-layout-box
    enabled: true
    options:
      title: Zweite
  - source: github:boxi-os/quartz-forms
    enabled: true
    options:
      transport:
        kind: none
      forms:
        kontakt:
          fields: [name]
        newsletter:
          fields: [mail]
  - source: @W@/source/.quartz-gui/authored-frames/frame-made
    enabled: true
layout:
  groups:
    nav:
      priority: 1
  byPageType:
    tag:
      exclude: [explorer]

configuration:
  pageTitle: Ziel
  locale: de-DE
  baseUrl: example.org
  theme:
    fontOrigin: googleFonts
    cdnCaching: true
    typography:
      header: Schibsted Grotesk
      body: Source Sans Pro
      code: IBM Plex Mono
    colors:
      lightMode:
        light: "#faf8f8"
        dark: "#2b2b2b"
      darkMode:
        light: "#161618"
        dark: "#ebebec"
plugins: []
